leaks.title: Delivery unit economics — some orders unprofitable
evidence: Average delivery revenue per order was USD 22.80.
For some orders, packaging, platform fees, discounts, and food costs combined exceeded the revenue from the order.
leaks.interpretation: The average delivery order generates USD 22.80 in revenue, yet for a subset of orders the combined variable costs (packaging, platform fees, discounts, and food costs) are higher than the order revenue, meaning those orders lose money on a per-order basis. The number of affected orders and the total loss amount are not known.

insufficient_evidence.reason: The evidence confirms some orders are unprofitable but does not provide the number of affected orders or the total loss amount, so the overall financial impact cannot be quantified.

The combined cost categories (packaging, platform fees, discounts, food costs) are reported only as a group; individual component amounts are not supplied, so it is not possible to isolate which component drives the loss.
